summary: Representative Begich has acknowledged serious risks from AI in general terms, without naming a catastrophic outcome. Representative Begich has said "we must work with experts to anticipate potential risks" from frontier AI, while other statements argue for federal rather than state AI rules, less regulation of data centers and moving fast to keep ahead.
Representative Palmer has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. The only statements on AI found from Representative Palmer are about the AI race with China.

Representative Sewell has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Representative Sewell's statements on AI are about co-sponsoring a pause on building large AI data centers over water, energy, environmental and community concerns, adding "I am not anti-AI, and I am certainly not anti-innovation".

Representative Crawford has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Representative Crawford has said "Frontier labs may soon achieve self-improving AI" and that the United States must get there first; other statements are about the AI race with China, intelligence agencies using AI and data centers.

Representative Hill has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Representative Hill has said "we must view AI as an opportunity, not a threat", and other statements are about AI in financial services and regulatory test programs for AI at financial regulators.

Representative Schweikert has not acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI. Representative Schweikert's statements on AI are about voice cloning, deepfakes, scams and fraud, warning "I see chaos coming in society", and about using AI to detect fraud in health care.

Representative Crane has acknowledged that AI could threaten human survival. At a hearing Representative Crane said that amid the AI race "we may be engineering our own destruction without realizing it." Other statements are about AI and jobs, foreign bots and the AI arms race with adversaries.

Representative Ansari has acknowledged that AI could threaten human survival or escape human control. Representative Ansari has said frontier AI and superintelligence "will outsmart humans and go beyond human control", has cited engineers' warnings that AI "could kill all humans", and calls for a pause on advanced AI and a ban on superintelligence.

Representative Stanton has acknowledged catastrophic risk from AI by co-signing a letter, but not in their own words. A letter they co-signed names "agentic misalignment, mass cybersecurity breaches, and development of biological or chemical weapons". In their own words, Representative Stanton has warned of rogue actors using AI for cyberattacks or "to build and release a bioweapon".
